dark-living-violet-oracle.title: The Violet Oracle

dark-living-winter-shoulder.title: On Winter’s Shoulder

dark-living-thorn-crown.title: The Thorn Crown
dark-living-thorn-crown.description: Dark thorns frame crimson flowers and an immense crown on a distant hill.

dark-living-black-tide.title: The Black Tide
dark-living-black-tide.description: Ivory stone frames slow turquoise waves above a hidden leviathan.

dark-living-golden-ruin.title: The Golden Ruin

dark-living-hollow-saint.title: The Hollow Saint

dark-living-fungal-throne.title: The Mycelium Throne

dark-living-storm-bridge.title: The Storm Bridge

dark-living-sand-library.title: Names Beneath the Sand

dark-living-jade-dragon.title: The Jade Dragon

creative-motion-skate-portal.title: The Sea Beyond

pixel-tv-wall.title: TV wall
pixel-tv-wall.description: Two banks of stacked CRT televisions in a dark gallery. Every screen plays your recording; the tubes light the wet floor and the room shifts from cold to neon.

pixel-moon-lake.title: Moon lake
pixel-moon-lake.description: Hand-drawn pixel night over a still lake: a haloed moon, aurora, shooting stars and a rippling reflection, gliding from midnight through aurora and dawn to sunset.

pixel-tv-lake.title: TVs on the lake
pixel-tv-lake.description: Old televisions standing in a pixel lake at night, glowing with your recording and reflected in the water while the sky cycles through neon and eclipse.

pixel-aurora-peaks.title: Aurora peaks
pixel-aurora-peaks.description: Snowy pixel mountains rise out of a frozen lake under curtains of aurora; the light slides from polar green to icy day and back to night.

pixel-neon-city.title: Neon harbour
pixel-neon-city.description: A pixel skyline over dark water: windows switch on and off by colour cycling and the whole city glows back from the harbour as the night turns neon.

pixel-desert-sun.title: Desert sun
pixel-desert-sun.description: Mesas and dunes under a huge striped sun; the sand glows from dusk to sunset and cools into a starry desert night.

pixel-lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
pixel-lighthouse.description: A sea cliff with a lighthouse whose beam sweeps the night over choppy water, from storm to moonlight and dawn.

pixel-firefly-forest.title: Firefly forest
pixel-firefly-forest.description: Tall pines around a forest lake, fireflies pulsing among the trees and in the reeds, under a green aurora.

pixel-planet-rise.title: Planet rise
pixel-planet-rise.description: A ringed planet rises over jagged alien peaks and a violet sea; its cloud bands drift by colour cycling while the light slides from alien teal to vapor neon.

pixel-night-train.title: Midnight train
pixel-night-train.description: A lit night train crosses a stone viaduct over a moonlit lake, its windows glowing on the water, as midnight slowly turns to dawn.

pixel-storm-lake.title: Storm on the lake
pixel-storm-lake.description: Rain lashes a dark pixel lake while lightning strikes the far ranges; every bolt lights the whole painted world for an instant and its thunder rolls in on cue.

pixel-volcano.title: Volcano
pixel-volcano.description: Rivers of lava run down a volcano by pure colour cycling, the crater glows and breathes smoke and embers, and the red spills across the sea under an eclipsed moon.

pixel-drive-in.title: Drive-in
pixel-drive-in.description: A desert drive-in under the stars: a huge screen plays your recording, rows of parked cars flash their brake lights, and the film light washes over the cars, sand and mesas.

pixel-cherry-garden.title: Cherry garden
pixel-cherry-garden.description: Blossoming cherry trees round a still pond, a pagoda with lit windows under a snowy peak, stone lanterns glowing and petals drifting down as the pink dusk turns to night.

pixel-coral-reef.title: Coral reef
pixel-coral-reef.description: Under the sea: shafts of sunlight shimmer down from a rippling surface, kelp sways over coral, two schools of fish cross in opposite directions and plankton glints, from a bright lagoon to the deep blue.

pixel-balloons.title: Balloons at dawn
pixel-balloons.description: Hot-air balloons drift and bob over a misty valley as the sun comes up, near ones large and slow, far ones small, all mirrored in the lake while dawn warms into sunset.

pixel-night-fair.title: Night fair
pixel-night-fair.description: A Ferris wheel turns over the harbour, its bulbs chasing round by colour cycling while the gondolas hang upright, striped tents glow under strings of lights and the whole fair shimmers in the water.

pixel-snow-village.title: Snowy village
pixel-snow-village.description: A snowed-in village at dusk: lit windows, a church steeple, smoke curling from the chimneys and skaters gliding across a frozen lake that mirrors it all as the snow keeps falling.

pixel-waterfall.title: Waterfall
pixel-waterfall.description: A waterfall pours between mossy cliffs by pure colour cycling, foam boils at its foot, a rainbow hangs in the spray and the jungle light turns to dusk and night.

pixel-orbit.title: Orbit
pixel-orbit.description: High above a planet: its curved horizon glows with atmosphere, city lights dot the night side, nebula clouds breathe among dense stars and a space station and tumbling asteroids drift by.

pixel-tulip-fields.title: Tulip fields
pixel-tulip-fields.description: Rows of red, yellow, pink and violet tulips run to the horizon in true perspective while windmills turn their sails against a sunset that fades through dusk to dawn.

pixel-neon-alley.title: Neon alley
pixel-neon-alley.description: A narrow street in the rain between tall façades: lit windows, fire escapes, shopfronts and neon signs that buzz and flicker, all mirrored in the wet ground, with the city glowing at the far end.

pixel-castle-fireworks.title: Castle fireworks
pixel-castle-fireworks.description: A castle on its hill with lit windows and banners while fireworks rise and burst in rings of embers that sag and fade, every burst mirrored in the lake below.

pixel-glow-tide.title: Glowing tide
pixel-glow-tide.description: A night beach where every wave glows blue as it breaks: bands of bioluminescent surf roll in across the wet sand by colour cycling, under a moon mirrored in the sea.

pixel-lantern-festival.title: Lantern festival
pixel-lantern-festival.description: Hundreds of paper lanterns rise slowly from a still lake at dusk, swaying as they climb and flickering warm, near ones faster than far ones, all mirrored in the water.

pixel-rainy-window.title: Rainy window
pixel-rainy-window.description: From a candle-lit room, the city at night through a window: rain slides down the glass, curtains frame the view and a plant and a candle sit on the sill while the harbour lights shimmer outside.

pixel-night-express.title: Night express
pixel-night-express.description: The view from a moving train: mountains glide by slowly, pine hills faster and telegraph poles flash past the window, all mirrored in a lake, while the moon keeps pace and dusk turns to an aurora night.

pixel-whole-day.title: A whole day
pixel-whole-day.description: A time-lapse over a lake: the sun rises in the east, arcs across the sky and sets in the west, then the moon follows, while the light turns from dawn to day, sunset and night and falls on actors from wherever the sun or moon stands.

pixel-eclipse.title: Eclipse
pixel-eclipse.description: Noon over red mesas: the moon slides across the sun, the desert dims to night in mid-afternoon, stars and the sun's corona appear, then day comes back as the moon moves on.

pixel-four-seasons.title: Four seasons
pixel-four-seasons.description: A whole year over a lake in one clip: trees blossom pink in spring, deepen to green in summer, flare orange and red in autumn as leaves drift down, then snow piles up level by level on the peaks and hills in winter, all by colour cycling.

pixel-cathedral.title: Cathedral
pixel-cathedral.description: Inside a Gothic nave: a great rose window and two lancets of stained glass glow in turn as the sun moves round, shafts of coloured light fall across the flagstones and dust motes turn slowly in the beams.

pixel-koi-pond.title: Koi pond
pixel-koi-pond.description: Looking down on a garden pond: koi circle slowly under lily pads and lotus flowers, sunlight ripples across the bottom in a net of caustics and petals drift onto the water.

pixel-moon-caravan.title: Moon caravan
pixel-moon-caravan.description: A camel caravan crosses the dunes in silhouette against a giant rising moon, legs stepping frame by frame as a guide leads the way, while dusk deepens to a starry desert night.

pixel-synthwave.title: Synthwave
pixel-synthwave.description: An endless neon grid flows toward you and pulses to a 120 BPM beat under a huge striped sun, with neon-rimmed mountains and palm silhouettes, from vapor pink to neon night.

pixel-monsoon.title: Monsoon
pixel-monsoon.description: Warm rain pours over a tropical lake: every drop that lands rings the water in spreading pixel ripples, palms and reeds stand in the downpour, and now and then lightning flares beyond the hills as the storm clears to green.

pixel-murmuration.title: Murmuration
pixel-murmuration.description: At sunset over a reed marsh, thousands of starlings wheel as one: the flock swells, folds and twists into ever-changing shapes as it drifts across the sky and its shadow crosses the still water.

pixel-night-launch.title: Night launch
pixel-night-launch.description: A rocket waits beside its lattice tower on a moonlit coast; at ignition the engines flare, smoke boils up and the rocket lifts off, gathering speed as it climbs while its light washes over the shore and slowly fades toward dawn.

pixel-crystal-cave.title: Crystal cave
pixel-crystal-cave.description: From the mouth of a cave hung with stalactites, a hidden underground lake glows with crystals whose light sweeps from cluster to cluster in waves, the whole grotto breathing their cyan-violet glow while drips ring the still water.

pixel-starry-night.title: Starry night
pixel-starry-night.description: A tribute to the painter's night: spiral swirls turn across a deep blue sky, stars pulse in rings of light, a crescent moon glows over the sleeping village and a cypress rises like a dark flame.

pixel-mist-rising.title: Mist rising
pixel-mist-rising.description: At dawn, ridge after ridge stands in banks of mist; as the sun climbs the mist burns off in dithered steps, the nearest bank first and the farthest last, until the whole valley is clear and green.

pixel-roadside-motel.title: Roadside motel
pixel-roadside-motel.description: A desert motel at night: its tall neon sign spells M-O-T-E-L letter by letter, flashes and starts again, an arrow of bulbs chases toward the office, VACANCY buzzes and the rooms glow under the stars.

pixel-tidal-abbey.title: Tidal abbey
pixel-tidal-abbey.description: An abbey on its rock, reached by a stone causeway at low tide; as the sun sets the tide comes in over the causeway and cuts the island off, then ebbs again under the night sky.

pixel-mirage.title: Mirage
pixel-mirage.description: A straight desert road at noon, its lines flowing past as if driving; heat haze makes the far mesas and dunes waver above a false lake of sky on the horizon, the glare fading to a red sunset.

pixel-cloud-shadows.title: Cloud shadows
pixel-cloud-shadows.description: A sunny afternoon over wide meadows: puffy clouds drift across the sky and their dithered shadows glide over the grass and flowers beneath them, until the light turns gold at sunset.

pixel-fjord.title: Fjord
pixel-fjord.description: The camera glides between the sheer walls of a fjord under the aurora: the near cliffs slide past faster than the snowy peaks at its end, revealing the depth of the painted world, all mirrored in the still water.

pixel-clockwork.title: Clockwork
pixel-clockwork.description: Inside a clock tower: a train of brass gears turns in mesh, each at the speed its size dictates and against its neighbour, above them a clock face keeps time and a pendulum swings to and fro before a riveted iron wall.

pixel-orrery.title: Orrery
pixel-orrery.description: A solar system seen from above: planets circle a glowing sun along faint orbit lines, the inner ones fastest as in nature, a ringed giant among them, a moon circling its planet as the planet circles the sun, and an asteroid belt turning slowly.

pixel-after-storm.title: After the storm
pixel-after-storm.description: Rain lashes the valley and lightning strikes the ridges; then the storm passes, the sky clears to a bright green afternoon and a rainbow dithers in over the mountains, glowing on into a warm evening.

pixel-city-rising.title: City rising
pixel-city-rising.description: A time-lapse of a city being built: from empty ground by the water, districts rise in waves, the far towers first and the waterfront last, while a day passes from dawn to a night full of lit windows.

pixel-jellyfish.title: Jellyfish
pixel-jellyfish.description: In the deep sea, glowing jellyfish rise at their own pace, each bell squeezing and relaxing with every stroke as its tentacles ripple behind, light sweeping through their bodies while marine snow drifts down past the reef.

pixel-blizzard.title: Blizzard
pixel-blizzard.description: A snowbound pass with a lone lit cabin: a blizzard thickens until the far peaks vanish into white and the near pines blur, only the cabin windows glowing through, then the storm eases and the mountains come back.

pixel-lantern-walk.title: Lantern walk
pixel-lantern-walk.description: A dark lakeside wood at night: one walker carries a lantern along the shore, and the pines, bank and reeds light up warm around it as it passes, then fall back into shadow.

pixel-empire-of-light.title: Empire of light
pixel-empire-of-light.description: After Magritte: a bright blue daytime sky with drifting white clouds over a house by a pond where night has already fallen — lit windows and a single street lamp glowing on the dark trees.

pixel-star-trails.title: Star trails
pixel-star-trails.description: A long exposure over a mountain lake: the stars slowly trace their arcs around the pole star as the shot goes on, doubled in the still water, above a lone tent lit from inside.

pixel-wheat-wind.title: Wheat in the wind
pixel-wheat-wind.description: A golden wheat field at sunset with a lone cypress: gusts roll across it in waves, bending the ears and running a pale sheen over the gold, while clouds drift by.

pixel-hockney-pool.title: Pool in the sun
pixel-hockney-pool.description: After Hockney: a flat pink house, two tall palms swaying and a pool whose floor swims with a moving net of caustics, as the bright California day turns to evening.

pixel-metaphysical-square.title: Metaphysical square
pixel-metaphysical-square.description: After De Chirico: a low sun crosses behind an arcade, a statue and a tall chimney, and their long shadows — arches and all — swing slowly across the empty square.

atmos-moon-low.title: Moon · low

atmos-mars-low.title: Mars · low
atmos-mars-low.description: The same desert from the dust, looking toward a caramel sky and two small moons.

atmos-snow-wide.title: Snow forest · wide
atmos-snow-wide.description: A procedural snow forest. The character spot stays on open snow, in front of the pines.

atmos-snow-low.title: Snow forest · low
atmos-snow-low.description: The same forest from the snow, looking toward a blue-hour sky and a warm cabin light.

atmos-desert-wide.title: Desert oasis · wide

atmos-desert-low.title: Desert oasis · low
atmos-desert-low.description: The same dunes from the sand, looking toward the palms and the water.

atmos-beach-wide.title: Sunset beach · wide
atmos-beach-wide.description: A procedural beach at golden hour. Waves and foam roll in, and the character spot stays on dry sand.

atmos-beach-low.title: Sunset beach · low
atmos-beach-low.description: The same shore from the sand, looking toward a beached boat and the water.

atmos-crystal-cave-wide.title: Crystal cave · wide
atmos-crystal-cave-wide.description: A procedural cave with no sun. Colored crystals light the floor, and the character spot stays on open stone.

atmos-crystal-cave-low.title: Crystal cave · low
atmos-crystal-cave-low.description: The same cave from the floor, looking toward a glowing cluster and the hanging crystals.

atmos-volcano-wide.title: Volcanic field · wide
atmos-volcano-wide.description: A procedural volcanic field under a red sky. Lava rivers glow, ash falls, and the character spot stays on open rock.

atmos-volcano-low.title: Volcanic field · low
atmos-volcano-low.description: The same field from the rock, looking along a lava river.

atmos-temple-wide.title: Jungle temple · wide
atmos-temple-wide.description: A procedural jungle temple. Light shafts fall between the vines, and the character spot stays on open stone.

atmos-temple-low.title: Jungle temple · low
atmos-temple-low.description: The same temple from the stone, looking toward mossy ruins and the butterflies.

atmos-reef-wide.title: Seafloor · wide
atmos-reef-wide.description: A procedural reef. Caustic light crosses open sand, and the character spot stays clear of the fish and rocks.

atmos-reef-low.title: Seafloor · low
atmos-reef-low.description: The same reef from the sand, looking toward a school of fish and rising bubbles.

atmos-neon-rain-wide.title: Neon rain alley · wide
atmos-neon-rain-wide.description: A procedural neon alley at night. Wet pavement reflects the signs, rain falls, and steam rises. The character spot stays on open pavement.

atmos-neon-rain-low.title: Neon rain alley · low
atmos-neon-rain-low.description: The same alley from the wet street, looking toward a cluster of signs and their reflections.

atmos-sky-islands-wide.title: Sky islands · wide
atmos-sky-islands-wide.description: Procedural floating islands in an N64 style. A colored checker covers the main island, and the character spot stays on that top.

atmos-sky-islands-low.title: Sky islands · low
atmos-sky-islands-low.description: The same islands from the checker, looking toward polygon clouds and spinning coins.

atmos-rooftop-night-wide.title: Rooftop at night · wide
atmos-rooftop-night-wide.description: A procedural rooftop at night. The city skyline glows behind it, and the character spot stays on the open roof.

atmos-rooftop-night-low.title: Rooftop at night · low
atmos-rooftop-night-low.description: The same roof from the slab, looking toward the parapet and the city.

atmos-retro-room-wide.title: Retro room · wide
atmos-retro-room-wide.description: A procedural 1990s room. A CRT, a console, and a controller sit clear of the open floor.

atmos-retro-room-low.title: Retro room · low
atmos-retro-room-low.description: The same room from the carpet, looking toward the CRT, the console, and the controller.

atmos-space-ring-wide.title: Ringed planet · wide
atmos-space-ring-wide.description: A procedural ringed planet and an asteroid field. The character spot stays on a pad in front of the planet.

atmos-space-ring-low.title: Ringed planet · low
atmos-space-ring-low.description: The same orbit from the pad, looking up toward the rings and the near asteroids.

atmos-silicon-grid-wide.title: Silicon grid · wide
atmos-silicon-grid-wide.description: A procedural neon grid plain. A striped sun, wire mountains, and the character spot stay on a dark pad.

atmos-silicon-grid-low.title: Silicon grid · low
atmos-silicon-grid-low.description: The same grid from the pad, looking across the lines toward the sun and the wire mountains.

atmos-silicon-circuit-wide.title: Silicon circuit · wide
atmos-silicon-circuit-wide.description: A procedural circuit-board city. Packages, capacitors, and a heatsink stay clear of the open pad.

atmos-silicon-circuit-low.title: Silicon circuit · low
atmos-silicon-circuit-low.description: The same board from the pad, looking across the traces toward the packages and the ridge.

atmos-silicon-mainframe-wide.title: Silicon mainframe · wide
atmos-silicon-mainframe-wide.description: A procedural mainframe hall. Cabinets, reels, and drives stay clear of the open aisle.

atmos-silicon-mainframe-low.title: Silicon mainframe · low
atmos-silicon-mainframe-low.description: The same hall from the aisle, looking toward the phosphor screens and the cabinet rows.

atmos-meadow-wide.title: Meadow · wide
atmos-meadow-wide.description: A procedural meadow under low clouds. Wind moves the grass, and the character spot stays on open ground.

atmos-meadow-low.title: Meadow · low
atmos-meadow-low.description: The same meadow from the grass, looking across the field and the low clouds.

cine-slow-zoom-in.title: Slow Zoom In
cine-slow-zoom-in.description: Camera movement. The lens tightens slowly on the face while the camera body stays put.

cine-slow-zoom-out.title: Slow Zoom Out
cine-slow-zoom-out.description: Camera movement. The lens opens slowly and lets the room back in around the face.

cine-crash-zoom-in.title: Crash Zoom In
cine-crash-zoom-in.description: Camera movement. A very fast snap onto the eyes.

cine-crash-zoom-out.title: Crash Zoom Out
cine-crash-zoom-out.description: Camera movement. A very fast widening, from the face out to the body.

cine-dolly-in.title: Dolly In
cine-dolly-in.description: Camera movement. The camera rolls closer and the perspective grows. The lens stays fixed.

cine-dolly-out.title: Dolly Out
cine-dolly-out.description: Camera movement. The camera rolls back and reveals more of the set. The lens stays fixed.

cine-dolly-left.title: Dolly Left
cine-dolly-left.description: Camera movement. A lateral dolly to the left at a constant distance.

cine-dolly-right.title: Dolly Right
cine-dolly-right.description: Camera movement. A lateral dolly to the right at a constant distance.

cine-pan-left.title: Pan Left
cine-pan-left.description: Camera movement. The camera stays planted and looks across to the left.

cine-pan-right.title: Pan Right
cine-pan-right.description: Camera movement. The camera stays planted and looks across to the right.

cine-tilt-up.title: Tilt Up
cine-tilt-up.description: Camera movement. The camera tilts from the torso up past the head.

cine-tilt-down.title: Tilt Down
cine-tilt-down.description: Camera movement. The camera tilts from the face down to the feet.

cine-whip-pan.title: Whip Pan
cine-whip-pan.description: Camera movement. A very fast look from one side to the other.

cine-whip-tilt.title: Whip Tilt
cine-whip-tilt.description: Camera movement. A very fast tilt from the floor to the ceiling.

cine-pedestal-up.title: Pedestal Up
cine-pedestal-up.description: Camera movement. The whole camera rises, still looking at the subject.

cine-pedestal-down.title: Pedestal Down
cine-pedestal-down.description: Camera movement. The whole camera descends, still looking at the subject.

cine-crane-up.title: Crane Up
cine-crane-up.description: Camera movement. The camera rises and pulls back, opening the shot.

cine-crane-down.title: Crane Down
cine-crane-down.description: Camera movement. The camera descends from a high wide view into a closer one.

cine-crane-over.title: Crane Over
cine-crane-over.description: Camera movement. The camera travels from the front, over the head, and looks down the back.

cine-jib.title: Jib Shot
cine-jib.description: Camera movement. A short jib rise, smaller than a full crane.

cine-orbit-360.title: 360-Degree Orbit
cine-orbit-360.description: Camera movement. A full circle around the subject at eye height.

cine-arc-left.title: Arc Left
cine-arc-left.description: Camera movement. A quarter-circle arc sliding to the left.

cine-arc-right.title: Arc Right
cine-arc-right.description: Camera movement. A quarter-circle arc sliding to the right.

cine-tracking.title: Tracking Shot
cine-tracking.description: Camera movement. The camera tracks alongside at a matched pace.

cine-follow.title: Follow Shot
cine-follow.description: Camera movement. The camera follows from behind the shoulders.

cine-steadicam.title: Steadicam
cine-steadicam.description: Camera movement. A smooth walking move that drifts in and a little sideways.

cine-handheld.title: Handheld
cine-handheld.description: Camera movement. A walking camera with a small roll, as if held by hand.

cine-gimbal.title: Gimbal Shot
cine-gimbal.description: Camera movement. A stabilized glide that pans across the subject.

cine-fpv-drone.title: FPV Drone
cine-fpv-drone.description: Camera movement. A low, fast, wide approach, the way a racing drone dives in.

cine-aerial-pullback.title: Aerial Pullback
cine-aerial-pullback.description: Camera movement. The view climbs and retreats until the subject is small in the set.

cine-aerial-push.title: Aerial Push In
cine-aerial-push.description: Camera movement. A high view drops and pushes in toward the subject.

cine-push-in.title: Push In
cine-push-in.description: Camera movement. A motivated push from a medium shot into the face.

cine-pull-out.title: Pull Out
cine-pull-out.description: Camera movement. A pull back from the face to a medium-wide view.

cine-static.title: Static Locked-Off
cine-static.description: Camera movement. A locked-off medium shot. Nothing in the camera moves.

cine-dolly-zoom.title: Dolly Zoom
cine-dolly-zoom.description: Camera movement. The camera pushes in while the lens widens, so the face stays a similar size and the background stretches.

cine-dutch-roll.title: Dutch Roll
cine-dutch-roll.description: Camera movement. The horizon rolls from one diagonal to the other.

cine-camera-roll.title: Camera Roll
cine-camera-roll.description: Camera movement. The camera rolls about a quarter turn around the lens axis.

cine-double-dolly.title: Double Dolly
cine-double-dolly.description: Camera movement. Subject and camera travel together, so the figure floats and the set slides behind.

cine-snorricam.title: SnorriCam
cine-snorricam.description: Camera movement. The face stays locked in frame while the body travels through the set.

cine-locked-on.title: Locked-On
cine-locked-on.description: Camera movement. The camera travels but the look stays glued to the subject.

cine-walk-and-talk.title: Walk and Talk
cine-walk-and-talk.description: Camera movement. Two figures walk and the camera tracks them from the front-side.

cine-hyperlapse.title: Hyperlapse
cine-hyperlapse.description: Camera movement. A long move played fast, the way a hyperlapse skips through space.

cine-slider.title: Slider Shot
cine-slider.description: Camera movement. A short, even lateral slide.

cine-lazy-susan.title: Lazy Susan
cine-lazy-susan.description: Camera movement. A lazy half-turn around the subject.

cine-bolt-cam.title: Bolt Cam
cine-bolt-cam.description: Camera movement. A very fast lateral pass, like a camera on a speed rail.

cine-aerial.title: Aerial
cine-aerial.description: Camera movement. A high circling view over the subject and the floor.

cine-arc.title: Arc
cine-arc.description: Camera movement. A gentle arc that shows both cheeks.

cine-choreo.title: Choreo
cine-choreo.description: Camera movement. Height and orbit change together, as a choreographed move.

cine-conveyor.title: Conveyor
cine-conveyor.description: Camera movement. A flat lateral pass, like the subject were on a belt.

cine-dolly.title: Dolly
cine-dolly.description: Camera movement. A straight dolly-in on the body.

cine-falling.title: Falling
cine-falling.description: Camera movement. The camera drops quickly from above to eye height.

cine-fixed-cam.title: Fixed Cam
cine-fixed-cam.description: Camera movement. A locked close view, tighter than the wide static shot.

cine-omnidirectional.title: Omnidirectional
cine-omnidirectional.description: Camera movement. A full high orbit, looking around the whole body.

cine-pan.title: Pan
cine-pan.description: Camera movement. A modest pan from just left of the subject to just right.

cine-parallax.title: Parallax
cine-parallax.description: Camera movement. A close lateral move so the subject shifts against the background.

cine-pass-through.title: Pass Through
cine-pass-through.description: Camera movement. The camera walks up to the subject and continues past.

cine-tilt.title: Tilt
cine-tilt.description: Camera movement. A short tilt from the chest to the eyes.

cine-trucking.title: Trucking
cine-trucking.description: Camera movement. A side truck that stays parallel to the subject.

cine-wandering.title: Wandering
cine-wandering.description: Camera movement. An unhurried path that changes height and angle, like someone looking around.

cine-zoom.title: Zoom
cine-zoom.description: Camera movement. A plain optical zoom in, with almost no change of perspective.

cine-eyes-in.title: Eyes In
cine-eyes-in.description: Camera movement. The frame settles on the eyes.

cine-mouth-in.title: Mouth In
cine-mouth-in.description: Camera movement. The frame drops onto the mouth.

cine-eating-zoom.title: Eating Zoom
cine-eating-zoom.description: Camera movement. A fast snap down onto the mouth, as a bite fills the frame.

cine-buckle-up.title: Buckle Up
cine-buckle-up.description: Camera movement. A low wide view from lap height, pushing toward the chest.

cine-car-chasing.title: Car Chasing
cine-car-chasing.description: Camera movement. A chase view from behind and a little above, on the street set.

cine-car-grip.title: Car Grip
cine-car-grip.description: Camera movement. A very low, close view along the side, as if mounted on the vehicle.

cine-road-rush.title: Road Rush
cine-road-rush.description: Camera movement. A wide, low rush toward the lens, on the street set.

cine-flying-cam-transition.title: Flying Cam Transition
cine-flying-cam-transition.description: Camera movement. The camera swings from a low front view up and over in one move.

cine-through-object-in.title: Through Object In
cine-through-object-in.description: Camera movement. The camera pushes from outside the figure until it is almost inside the frame.

cine-through-object-out.title: Through Object Out
cine-through-object-out.description: Camera movement. The camera starts very close and withdraws through the frame.

cine-super-dolly-in.title: Super Dolly In
cine-super-dolly-in.description: Camera movement. A long, fast dolly from far away into a close view.

cine-super-dolly-out.title: Super Dolly Out
cine-super-dolly-out.description: Camera movement. A long, fast dolly from a close view out to a wide one.

cine-dolly-zoom-in.title: Dolly Zoom In
cine-dolly-zoom-in.description: Camera movement. Push in and widen the lens: the face holds, the background swells.

cine-dolly-zoom-out.title: Dolly Zoom Out
cine-dolly-zoom-out.description: Camera movement. Pull back and tighten the lens: the face holds, the background compresses.

cine-yoyo-zoom.title: YoYo Zoom
cine-yoyo-zoom.description: Camera movement. A fast optical snap in. The stage plays the move once, inward.

cine-rapid-zoom-in.title: Rapid Zoom In
cine-rapid-zoom-in.description: Camera movement. A quick optical punch-in.

cine-rapid-zoom-out.title: Rapid Zoom Out
cine-rapid-zoom-out.description: Camera movement. A quick optical widening.

cine-head-tracking.title: Head Tracking
cine-head-tracking.description: Camera movement. A close arc that keeps the head centered.

cine-hero-cam.title: Hero Cam
cine-hero-cam.description: Camera movement. A low push that looks up, the way a hero shot does.

cine-robo-arm.title: Robo Arm
cine-robo-arm.description: Camera movement. A precise arc that also climbs, like a rig arm.

cine-wiggle.title: Wiggle
cine-wiggle.description: Camera movement. A short unstable move with roll in both directions.

cine-3d-rotation.title: 3D Rotation
cine-3d-rotation.description: Camera movement. Orbit and roll together, so the subject turns in space.

cine-crane-over-the-head.title: Crane Over The Head
cine-crane-over-the-head.description: Camera movement. The camera crests directly over the head and looks down the crown.

cine-earth-zoom.title: Earth Zoom
cine-earth-zoom.description: Camera movement. A long move from a far high view down into a human-scale shot.

cine-jib-down.title: Jib Down
cine-jib-down.description: Camera movement. A short jib drop into a closer view.

cine-jib-up.title: Jib Up
cine-jib-up.description: Camera movement. A short jib rise that opens a little.

cine-extreme-close-up.title: Extreme Close-Up
cine-extreme-close-up.description: Framing. Eyes and mouth fill the frame.

cine-choker.title: Choker Shot
cine-choker.description: Framing. A choker framing, from just under the lips to the top of the head.

cine-close-up.title: Close-Up
cine-close-up.description: Framing. A close-up of the face.

cine-cowboy-shot.title: Cowboy Shot
cine-cowboy-shot.description: Framing. From mid-thigh up, the western cowboy frame.

cine-full-body.title: Full Body
cine-full-body.description: Framing. The whole body, with a little floor and a little headroom.

cine-long-shot.title: Long Shot
cine-long-shot.description: Framing. The figure is readable and the set has room around it.

cine-extreme-long-shot.title: Extreme Long Shot
cine-extreme-long-shot.description: Framing. The figure is small and the place dominates.

cine-establishing-shot.title: Establishing Shot
cine-establishing-shot.description: Framing. A wide view that introduces the place, with the figure inside it.

cine-master-shot.title: Master Shot
cine-master-shot.description: Framing. A wide locked view that can cover two people.

cine-two-shot.title: Two-Shot
cine-two-shot.description: Framing. Two people share a medium-wide frame.

cine-three-shot.title: Three-Shot
cine-three-shot.description: Framing. Three figures in one frame.

cine-group-shot.title: Group Shot
cine-group-shot.description: Framing. A wider three-figure group, with air on both sides.

cine-insert.title: Insert Shot
cine-insert.description: Framing. A tight insert on the torso, where hands and props read.

cine-cutaway.title: Cutaway
cine-cutaway.description: Framing. The look leaves the face and rests on the space beside them.

cine-reaction-shot.title: Reaction Shot
cine-reaction-shot.description: Framing. A close three-quarter view for a reaction.

cine-over-the-shoulder-frame.title: Over-the-Shoulder Coverage
cine-over-the-shoulder-frame.description: Framing. From behind one shoulder, looking toward the other person.

cine-single.title: Single
cine-single.description: Framing. One person, clean medium framing.

cine-cut-ins.title: Cut-ins
cine-cut-ins.description: Framing. A tighter insert than the coverage, aimed at the chest.

cine-gesture.title: Gesture
cine-gesture.description: Framing. Framing for a hand or torso gesture.

cine-interview.title: Interview
cine-interview.description: Framing. A three-quarter interview angle, with room in the look direction.

cine-product.title: Product
cine-product.description: Framing. A clean, slightly high view suited to an object on the subject.

cine-video-portraits.title: Video Portraits
cine-video-portraits.description: Framing. Head and shoulders with a very small drift.

cine-wide-shot.title: Wide Shot
cine-wide-shot.description: Framing. A wide shot of the figure in the set.

cine-eye-level.title: Eye Level
cine-eye-level.description: Camera angle. The lens sits at eye height.

cine-high-angle.title: High Angle
cine-high-angle.description: Camera angle. The camera looks down on the subject.

cine-low-angle.title: Low Angle
cine-low-angle.description: Camera angle. The camera looks up, and the subject gains height.

cine-birds-eye.title: Bird's-Eye View
cine-birds-eye.description: Camera angle. Almost straight down, a little off the vertical.

cine-worms-eye.title: Worm's-Eye View
cine-worms-eye.description: Camera angle. From the floor, looking sharply up.

cine-overhead.title: Overhead Top-Down
cine-overhead.description: Camera angle. A top-down view, nearly on the vertical.

cine-ground-level.title: Ground Level
cine-ground-level.description: Camera angle. The lens is just above the floor.

cine-dutch-angle.title: Dutch Angle
cine-dutch-angle.description: Camera angle. The horizon is canted and stays there.

cine-pov.title: Point of View
cine-pov.description: Camera angle. The camera sits at the eyes and looks out into the set.

cine-profile.title: Profile
cine-profile.description: Camera angle. A pure side view of the head.

cine-three-quarter.title: Three-Quarter Angle
cine-three-quarter.description: Camera angle. The classic three-quarter angle.

cine-reverse-angle.title: Reverse Angle
cine-reverse-angle.description: Camera angle. The camera stands on the far side and looks back.

cine-trunk-shot.title: Trunk Shot
cine-trunk-shot.description: Camera angle. A low wide view looking up, as from inside a trunk.

cine-hip-level.title: Hip Level
cine-hip-level.description: Camera angle. The lens sits about at the hip.

cine-shoulder-level.title: Shoulder Level
cine-shoulder-level.description: Camera angle. The lens sits just below the eyes, at the shoulder.

cine-first-person.title: First-Person
cine-first-person.description: Camera angle. A wide view from the eyes, looking forward.

cine-fourth-wall.title: Fourth Wall
cine-fourth-wall.description: Camera angle. Straight into the lens, as if the subject addresses us.

cine-object-pov.title: Object POV
cine-object-pov.description: Camera angle. A low view from object height, looking up at the person.

cine-incline.title: Incline
cine-incline.description: Camera angle. The camera and the horizon both lean, as on a slope.

cine-three-point-lighting.title: Three-Point Lighting
cine-three-point-lighting.description: Lighting. A frontal key with enough level to read the face, the usual three-point balance reduced to the single stage lamp.

cine-key-light.title: Key Light
cine-key-light.description: Lighting. One hard key from the left, and little else.

cine-fill-light.title: Fill Light
cine-fill-light.description: Lighting. A soft, dim frontal fill with the contrast pulled down.

cine-backlight.title: Backlight
cine-backlight.description: Lighting. The lamp sits behind the subject and draws a bright edge.

cine-rim-light.title: Rim Light
cine-rim-light.description: Lighting. A rim from the back-right separates the shoulder from the set.

cine-kicker.title: Kicker
cine-kicker.description: Lighting. A cool kicker from the back-left catches the other edge.

cine-hair-light.title: Hair Light
cine-hair-light.description: Lighting. A high back light sits on the hair.

cine-eye-light.title: Eye Light
cine-eye-light.description: Lighting. A small frontal lamp aimed at the eyes.

cine-high-key.title: High-Key Lighting
cine-high-key.description: Lighting. A bright, open key with soft shadows.

cine-low-key.title: Low-Key Lighting
cine-low-key.description: Lighting. Most of the face falls into shadow. One edge remains.

cine-chiaroscuro.title: Chiaroscuro
cine-chiaroscuro.description: Lighting. A painterly split between a lit plane and a deep shadow.

cine-rembrandt.title: Rembrandt Lighting
cine-rembrandt.description: Lighting. A three-quarter key that leaves the far cheek mostly dark.

cine-butterfly-lighting.title: Butterfly Lighting
cine-butterfly-lighting.description: Lighting. A high frontal key, the beauty light that sits over the nose.

cine-loop-lighting.title: Loop Lighting
cine-loop-lighting.description: Lighting. A key a little off axis, between Rembrandt and butterfly.

cine-split-lighting.title: Split Lighting
cine-split-lighting.description: Lighting. Half the face is lit and half is left dark.

cine-short-lighting.title: Short Lighting
cine-short-lighting.description: Lighting. The key hits the far side of a three-quarter face.

cine-broad-lighting.title: Broad Lighting
cine-broad-lighting.description: Lighting. The key hits the near side of a three-quarter face.

cine-silhouette.title: Silhouette
cine-silhouette.description: Lighting. A strong backlight and a dark front turn the body into a shape.

cine-motivated-lighting.title: Motivated Lighting
cine-motivated-lighting.description: Lighting. The key comes from one side, as if a window just off camera were the source.

cine-practical-lighting.title: Practical Lighting
cine-practical-lighting.description: Lighting. A warm, low lamp, the color of a practical bulb.

cine-available-light.title: Available Light
cine-available-light.description: Lighting. A cool, modest level, as if only the room light were on.

cine-naturalistic-ambient.title: Naturalistic Ambient
cine-naturalistic-ambient.description: Lighting. Soft warm ambient light, without a theatrical edge.

cine-bounce-light.title: Bounce Light
cine-bounce-light.description: Lighting. The lamp comes from low and in front, like light bounced off the floor.

cine-hard-light.title: Hard Light
cine-hard-light.description: Lighting. A small, hard source and a sharp shadow line.

cine-soft-light.title: Soft Light
cine-soft-light.description: Lighting. A broad, dim source and an open shadow.

cine-under-light.title: Underlighting
cine-under-light.description: Lighting. The lamp is under the face.

cine-cross-lighting.title: Cross Lighting
cine-cross-lighting.description: Lighting. A steep side-front key, the single-lamp version of a cross.

cine-window-light.title: Window Light
cine-window-light.description: Lighting. Daylight from a side window.

cine-candlelight.title: Candlelight
cine-candlelight.description: Lighting. A dim orange source, low and close.

cine-neon-practical.title: Neon Practicals
cine-neon-practical.description: Lighting. A magenta practical, the color of a neon sign.

cine-golden-hour.title: Golden Hour
cine-golden-hour.description: Lighting. A low, warm sun from the side.

cine-blue-hour.title: Blue Hour
cine-blue-hour.description: Lighting. The cool, low light after sunset.

cine-dappled-light.title: Dappled Light
cine-dappled-light.description: Lighting. Warm side light in the jungle set, where the canopy would break the sun.

cine-gobo-lighting.title: Gobo Lighting
cine-gobo-lighting.description: Lighting. A hard side key. The stage lamp cannot cut a pattern, so the shadow edge is a single line.

cine-volumetric-light.title: Volumetric Light
cine-volumetric-light.description: Lighting. Backlight plus haze, so the beam in front of the figure can read.

cine-cameo-lighting.title: Cameo Lighting
cine-cameo-lighting.description: Lighting. A pool of light from above and a darker surround.

cine-epiphany.title: Epiphany
cine-epiphany.description: Lighting. A high warm backlight, as if the shot were a revelation.

cine-spotlight.title: Spotlight
cine-spotlight.description: Lighting. A hard overhead spot on an otherwise dim stage.

cine-glam.title: Glam
cine-glam.description: Lighting. A bright beauty key, a little above the eyes.

cine-rule-of-thirds.title: Rule of Thirds
cine-rule-of-thirds.description: Composition. The face sits on the left third, with open space to the right.

cine-golden-ratio.title: Golden Ratio
cine-golden-ratio.description: Composition. The face sits a little inside the left third, near the golden section.

cine-central-framing.title: Central Framing
cine-central-framing.description: Composition. The subject is dead center.

cine-centered-composition.title: Centered Composition
cine-centered-composition.description: Composition. A formal, centered tableau of one figure.

cine-symmetry.title: Symmetry
cine-symmetry.description: Composition. Two figures balanced on either side of the lens axis.

cine-asymmetry.title: Asymmetry
cine-asymmetry.description: Composition. One figure pushed far to the side, with the weight off center.

cine-leading-lines.title: Leading Lines
cine-leading-lines.description: Composition. A low centered view down the street, so the set lines converge.

cine-frame-in-frame.title: Frame within Frame
cine-frame-in-frame.description: Composition. A foreground prop crowds the edge and the subject sits in the gap.

cine-negative-space.title: Negative Space
cine-negative-space.description: Composition. The figure is small on the left and most of the frame is empty.

cine-foreground-interest.title: Foreground Interest
cine-foreground-interest.description: Composition. A large foreground prop leads into the figure behind it.

cine-layered-depth.title: Layered Depth
cine-layered-depth.description: Composition. Prop, hero and a second figure sit on three depths.

cine-diagonal-composition.title: Diagonal Composition
cine-diagonal-composition.description: Composition. The horizon leans and the figure sits on a diagonal.

cine-triangular-composition.title: Triangular Composition
cine-triangular-composition.description: Composition. Three figures form a triangle.

cine-headroom.title: Headroom
cine-headroom.description: Composition. The look sits high, so there is room above the hair.

cine-lead-room.title: Lead Room
cine-lead-room.description: Composition. Open space on the right, in the direction the body faces.

cine-short-siding.title: Short Siding
cine-short-siding.description: Composition. The face is pushed against the near edge, with little room in front of the look.

cine-visual-weight.title: Visual Weight
cine-visual-weight.description: Composition. A low angle and an off-center body make the figure heavy in the frame.

cine-repetition-pattern.title: Repetition and Pattern
cine-repetition-pattern.description: Composition. Three figures repeat across the frame at the same height.

cine-figure-ground.title: Figure-Ground
cine-figure-ground.description: Composition. A silhouetted figure against a bright back light.

cine-contrast-composition.title: Tonal Contrast
cine-contrast-composition.description: Composition. A hard side light makes the tonal split the composition.

cine-one-point-perspective.title: One-Point Perspective
cine-one-point-perspective.description: Composition. The lens sits on the street axis, so the set vanishes to one point.

cine-vanishing-point.title: Vanishing Point
cine-vanishing-point.description: Composition. A lower, wider view aimed down the same street axis.

cine-dirty-frame.title: Dirty Frame
cine-dirty-frame.description: Composition. A foreground shape cuts into the frame on purpose.

cine-clean-frame.title: Clean Frame
cine-clean-frame.description: Composition. Nothing competes with the figure. The edges stay empty.

cine-look-space.title: Look Space
cine-look-space.description: Composition. Room in front of the face, the practical form of lead room.

cine-architexture.title: Architexture
cine-architexture.description: Composition. A low wide view that gives the citadel the frame.

cine-reflections.title: Reflections
cine-reflections.description: Composition. The floor mirrors the figure.

cine-screen-in-screen.title: Screen in Screen
cine-screen-in-screen.description: Composition. The figure is staged small, with the set reading as a frame around a frame.

cine-tableau.title: Tableau
cine-tableau.description: Composition. A locked, frontal, formal arrangement of three figures.

cine-void.title: Void
cine-void.description: Composition. The figure stands in an empty, dim stage.

cine-voyeur.title: Voyeur
cine-voyeur.description: Composition. A long lens from off to the side, as if the shot were watched from a corner.

cine-windows.title: Windows
cine-windows.description: Composition. Side window light and a frame that keeps the figure near the light.

cine-ultra-wide-14mm.title: 14mm Ultra-Wide
cine-ultra-wide-14mm.description: Lens. A very wide lens close to the body, with strong perspective.

cine-24mm-wide.title: 24mm Wide
cine-24mm-wide.description: Lens. A wide lens, still close enough to feel the room.

cine-35mm-moderate.title: 35mm Moderate Wide
cine-35mm-moderate.description: Lens. A moderate wide lens at a natural distance.

cine-50mm-normal.title: 50mm Normal
cine-50mm-normal.description: Lens. The ordinary lens: perspective close to standing nearby.

cine-85mm-portrait.title: 85mm Portrait
cine-85mm-portrait.description: Lens. A short telephoto. The camera steps back so the head stays the same size.

cine-135mm-telephoto.title: 135mm Telephoto
cine-135mm-telephoto.description: Lens. A longer lens and a farther camera. The background packs in.

cine-200mm-long.title: 200mm Long Telephoto
cine-200mm-long.description: Lens. A very long lens. The camera is far and the set stacks behind the face.

cine-anamorphic.title: Anamorphic
cine-anamorphic.description: Lens. A wider field and a low horizon. The stage stays 16:9, without an anamorphic squeeze.

cine-spherical.title: Spherical
cine-spherical.description: Lens. A normal spherical lens at a straightforward distance.

cine-fisheye.title: Fisheye
cine-fisheye.description: Lens. An extreme wide lens very close to the body.

cine-tilt-shift.title: Tilt-Shift
cine-tilt-shift.description: Lens. A high view looking down. The stage has no tilt-shift blur, so the miniature feel comes from the angle.

cine-macro.title: Macro
cine-macro.description: Lens. Very close on the chest, the way a macro frame isolates a detail.

cine-probe-lens.title: Probe Lens
cine-probe-lens.description: Lens. A wide lens almost on the floor, pushed toward the feet.

cine-split-diopter.title: Split Diopter
cine-split-diopter.description: Lens. Two people at two depths in one deep frame. Focus does not split.

cine-vintage-cine.title: Vintage Cine Glass
cine-vintage-cine.description: Lens. A normal lens with a warm, slightly dim lamp.

cine-compression.title: Telephoto Compression
cine-compression.description: Lens. A long lens from far away, so near and far sit on top of each other.

cine-magnification.title: Magnification
cine-magnification.description: Lens. A tight lens on a small area of the face.

cine-teal-orange.title: Teal and Orange
cine-teal-orange.description: Color. A teal lamp on a warm-looking set, the two-tone grade in one light.

cine-bleach-bypass.title: Bleach Bypass
cine-bleach-bypass.description: Color. A hard, desaturated key with deep shadows.

cine-monochrome.title: Monochrome
cine-monochrome.description: Color. A neutral gray lamp. The stage does not strip hue from textures.

cine-sepia.title: Sepia
cine-sepia.description: Color. A brown-gold lamp over the whole figure.

cine-desaturation.title: Desaturation
cine-desaturation.description: Color. A pale, low lamp, the quiet end of the grade.

cine-cool-blue.title: Cool Blue
cine-cool-blue.description: Color. The whole key is blue.

cine-warm-amber.title: Warm Amber
cine-warm-amber.description: Color. The whole key is amber.

cine-filmic-faded.title: Filmic Faded
cine-filmic-faded.description: Color. A dim, warm, low-contrast lamp.

cine-cross-process.title: Cross Process
cine-cross-process.description: Color. A sickly green-yellow key, the cross-process cast.

cine-day-for-night.title: Day for Night
cine-day-for-night.description: Color. A dim blue key that plays a day set as night.

cine-moonlight-gel.title: Moonlight Gel
cine-moonlight-gel.description: Color. A pale blue gel from above and behind.

cine-split-tone.title: Split Toning
cine-split-tone.description: Color. Teal in the key and a warm dressing behind it.

cine-natural-grade.title: Natural Grade
cine-natural-grade.description: Color. A modest warm key, close to an ungraded daylight lamp.

cine-color-shift.title: Color Shift
cine-color-shift.description: Color. The move starts under a cool key. The lamp itself does not animate.

cine-vintage.title: Vintage
cine-vintage.description: Color. Sepia light and a slightly farther, softer frame.

cine-palette.title: Palette
cine-palette.description: Color. A single saturated accent, here magenta, over a plain pose.

cine-overexposed.title: Overexposed
cine-overexposed.description: Color. The key is pushed very high and the face blows toward white.

cine-slow-motion.title: Slow Motion
cine-slow-motion.description: Time. A short push played at quarter speed.

cine-fast-motion.title: Fast Motion
cine-fast-motion.description: Time. A long lateral move played at double speed.

cine-speed-ramp.title: Speed Ramp
cine-speed-ramp.description: Time. A long dolly that eases in and eases out, slow at the ends and quicker through the middle.

cine-freeze-frame.title: Freeze Frame
cine-freeze-frame.description: Time. A locked frame. The pose does not advance.

cine-time-lapse.title: Time-Lapse
cine-time-lapse.description: Time. A wide orbit played fast, so the view skips around the figure.

cine-step-printing.title: Step Printing
cine-step-printing.description: Time. A slow orbit. The stage does not drop frames, so the stutter is only the pace.

cine-reverse-motion.title: Reverse Motion
cine-reverse-motion.description: Time. The dolly runs backward, from close to far.

cine-bullet-time.title: Bullet Time
cine-bullet-time.description: Time. A fast orbit at half speed, the frozen-moment circle.

cine-long-take.title: Long Take
cine-long-take.description: Time. One continuous path that arcs and closes in, without a cut.

cine-one-er.title: Oner
cine-one-er.description: Time. A shorter single take: rise, arc and land on the face.

cine-motion-blur.title: Motion Blur
cine-motion-blur.description: Time. A fast lateral truck. The renderer does not add motion blur.

cine-stutter.title: Stutter / Stop-Stutter
cine-stutter.description: Time. A hesitant short push. Frames are not dropped.

cine-boomerang.title: Boomerang
cine-boomerang.description: Time. A snap in. The shot does not play back out.

cine-infinite-loop.title: Infinite Loop
cine-infinite-loop.description: Time. A full orbit that can repeat without a jump in angle.

cine-stop-motion.title: Stop Motion
cine-stop-motion.description: Time. A locked pose. The model is not stepped like a puppet.

cine-low-shutter.title: Low Shutter
cine-low-shutter.description: Time. A fast pan, the kind of move a low shutter would smear.

cine-timelapse-glam.title: Timelapse Glam
cine-timelapse-glam.description: Time. A beauty frame played fast under a glam key.

cine-timelapse-human.title: Timelapse Human
cine-timelapse-human.description: Time. A medium orbit of the figure, played fast.

cine-timelapse-landscape.title: Timelapse Landscape
cine-timelapse-landscape.description: Time. A high wide orbit of the place, played fast.

cine-frozen-in-motion.title: Frozen in Motion
cine-frozen-in-motion.description: Time. An orbit at quarter speed, as if the moment were held.

cine-moonwalk.title: Moonwalk
cine-moonwalk.description: Time. The figure travels backward while the camera holds a front view.

cine-lens-flare.title: Lens Flare
cine-lens-flare.description: Effect. A low sun-style key aimed into the lens. There is no flare pass.

cine-anamorphic-flare.title: Anamorphic Flare
cine-anamorphic-flare.description: Effect. A wide, low, bright frame. Streaks are not drawn.

cine-halation.title: Halation
cine-halation.description: Effect. A warm backlight that blooms the edge of the figure.

cine-film-grain.title: Film Grain
cine-film-grain.description: Effect. A contrasty close frame. Grain is not applied.

cine-bokeh.title: Bokeh
cine-bokeh.description: Effect. A short telephoto on the face, the framing where background blur would live.

cine-double-exposure.title: Double Exposure
cine-double-exposure.description: Effect. Two figures share one frame, slightly offset, the way a double exposure stacks bodies.

cine-rack-focus.title: Rack Focus
cine-rack-focus.description: Effect. A push from a far figure to a near one. Focus is not racked.

cine-shallow-focus.title: Shallow Focus
cine-shallow-focus.description: Effect. A close portrait lens, the setup for a shallow plane of focus.

cine-deep-focus.title: Deep Focus
cine-deep-focus.description: Effect. A stopped-down wide view with two depths in acceptable size.

cine-forced-perspective.title: Forced Perspective
cine-forced-perspective.description: Effect. A near prop is scaled up and a far figure is scaled down.

cine-light-leak.title: Light Leak
cine-light-leak.description: Effect. A hot edge light from the side, standing in for a leak.

cine-vignette.title: Vignette
cine-vignette.description: Effect. A pool of light in the center and a darker grade around it.

cine-chromatic-aberration.title: Chromatic Aberration
cine-chromatic-aberration.description: Effect. A wide lens close to the figure, where color fringes would show. Fringes are not drawn.

cine-infrared.title: Infrared
cine-infrared.description: Effect. A pale, high-key, slightly magenta grade.

cine-night-vision.title: Night Vision
cine-night-vision.description: Effect. A dim green grade on a dark stage.

cine-slit-scan.title: Slit-Scan
cine-slit-scan.description: Effect. A long lateral pass, the move a slit-scan would smear. The image is not sliced.

cine-kaleidoscope.title: Kaleidoscope
cine-kaleidoscope.description: Effect. A centered, slightly rolled orbit. The frame is not mirrored.

cine-light-flash.title: Light Flash
cine-light-flash.description: Effect. A very bright key for a short beat.

cine-projection-mapping.title: Projections
cine-projection-mapping.description: Effect. The figure stands in a dim set with a cool frontal wash, as if a projection hit them.

cine-match-morph.title: Morph
cine-match-morph.description: Effect. A push from one figure to the other. The mesh does not morph.

cine-altered-state.title: Altered State
cine-altered-state.description: Effect. A rolled, wide, acid-colored drift.

cine-anthropo.title: Anthropo
cine-anthropo.description: Effect. A low, close, wide view that stretches the body toward the lens.

cine-cinemagraph.title: Cinemagraph
cine-cinemagraph.description: Effect. A locked portrait. Only a later animation on the model would move.

cine-collage.title: Collage
cine-collage.description: Effect. Three figures packed into one flat, graphic frame.

cine-datamosh.title: Datamosh
cine-datamosh.description: Effect. A fast broken push with roll. Pixels are not melted.

cine-diorama.title: Diorama
cine-diorama.description: Effect. A high view down onto the figure, like a tabletop scene.

cine-distortions.title: Distortions
cine-distortions.description: Effect. A fisheye-close frame. The mesh is not warped.

cine-duplication.title: Duplication
cine-duplication.description: Effect. The same staging twice: two figures side by side.

cine-echo-print.title: Echo Print
cine-echo-print.description: Effect. A figure and a second figure set just behind, like an echo.

cine-feedback.title: Feedback
cine-feedback.description: Effect. A push into the face under a hot key, the start of a video feedback loop.

cine-floating-ui.title: Floating UI
cine-floating-ui.description: Effect. A clean, slightly high product frame with room for type. No type is drawn.

cine-focal-shift.title: Focal Shift
cine-focal-shift.description: Effect. The lens widens while the camera holds, a focal-length change.

cine-generative.title: Generative
cine-generative.description: Effect. A slow orbit under a shifting-looking magenta grade. The mesh is not regenerated.

cine-levitation.title: Levitation
cine-levitation.description: Effect. The figure is raised off the floor and turns slowly.

cine-masking.title: Masking
cine-masking.description: Effect. A tight frame that crops the body, the way a mask would.

cine-mixed-media.title: Mixed Media
cine-mixed-media.description: Effect. A figure in the workshop set under a paper-colored key.

cine-morphing.title: Morphing
cine-morphing.description: Effect. A move from a wide body view into the face. The mesh does not blend.

cine-object-portal.title: Object Portal
cine-object-portal.description: Effect. The camera pushes toward the figure as if through an opening, with a gate in the world effects.

cine-photogrammetry.title: Photogrammetry
cine-photogrammetry.description: Effect. A slow orbit, the way a scan presents an object.

cine-ratio-switch.title: Ratio Switch
cine-ratio-switch.description: Effect. The same close view, switched into a vertical frame.

cine-scale-shift.title: Scale Shift
cine-scale-shift.description: Effect. The camera rushes from a tiny wide view to a huge close one.

cine-shadow-box.title: Shadow Box
cine-shadow-box.description: Effect. A hard side light and a square-on frame, like a shadow box.

cine-transformation.title: Transformation
cine-transformation.description: Effect. A crane down onto the figure while a shockwave marks the beat.

cine-typography.title: Typography
cine-typography.description: Effect. A clean centered frame with headroom left for a title. No letters are set.

cine-wigglegram.title: Wigglegram
cine-wigglegram.description: Effect. Two close side views, played as a short lateral wiggle.

cine-x-ray.title: X-Ray
cine-x-ray.description: Effect. A pale, cold, high-key grade on a straight-on body.

cine-zoetrope.title: Zoetrope
cine-zoetrope.description: Effect. A full orbit, the loop a zoetrope would spin.

cine-focus-change.title: Focus Change
cine-focus-change.description: Effect. The frame travels from a side prop to the face.

cine-floating-fall.title: Floating Fall
cine-floating-fall.description: Effect. The figure drops slowly while the camera stays with the torso.

cine-smash-and-grab.title: Smash and Grab
cine-smash-and-grab.description: Effect. A crash in, then the energy of a fast push. One move, inward.

cine-cyclope.title: Cyclope
cine-cyclope.description: Effect. An extreme close-up centered between the eyes.

cine-particles.title: Particles
cine-particles.description: Effect. Sparks drift around a backlit figure.

cine-argus.title: Argus
cine-argus.description: Effect. A high, many-angled orbit, as if several eyes circled at once.

cine-sticker-peel.title: Sticker Peel
cine-sticker-peel.description: Effect. The camera peels off a flat frontal view into a side angle.

cine-selfie-twin.title: Selfie Twin
cine-selfie-twin.description: Effect. Two faces close to a wide lens.

cine-bubbles.title: Bubbles
cine-bubbles.description: Effect. Bubbles rise in front of a cool, close frame.

cine-match-cut.title: Match Cut
cine-match-cut.description: Editing. The frame holds a centered close view, the shape a match cut would land on.

cine-graphic-match.title: Graphic Match
cine-graphic-match.description: Editing. A rolled, graphic close view, matched by shape rather than by story.

cine-match-action.title: Match on Action
cine-match-action.description: Editing. A side view that continues a gesture across the frame.

cine-jump-cut.title: Jump Cut
cine-jump-cut.description: Editing. The size jumps along the same axis, the way a jump cut resets the frame.

cine-smash-cut.title: Smash Cut
cine-smash-cut.description: Editing. An abrupt snap from wide to close.

cine-dissolve.title: Dissolve
cine-dissolve.description: Editing. A slow ease from one distance to another. The picture does not dissolve.

cine-fade.title: Fade In / Fade Out
cine-fade.description: Editing. The shot lands on a still, dim frame, the way a fade arrives.

cine-wipe.title: Wipe
cine-wipe.description: Editing. A hard lateral pass, the gesture of a wipe.

cine-iris.title: Iris
cine-iris.description: Editing. A zoom into the center, the way an iris closes.

cine-cross-cut.title: Cross-Cutting
cine-cross-cut.description: Editing. The look swings from one person to the other.

cine-split-screen.title: Split Screen
cine-split-screen.description: Editing. Two people held in one wide frame, each on a side.

cine-montage.title: Montage
cine-montage.description: Editing. A crane that travels the set, the way a montage would skip through places.

cine-axial-cut.title: Axial Cut
cine-axial-cut.description: Editing. A cut straight down the lens axis, from medium to close.

cine-invisible-cut.title: Invisible Cut
cine-invisible-cut.description: Editing. The camera passes very close, where a hidden cut would hide.

cine-l-cut-visual.title: J-Cut / L-Cut (Visual Setup)
cine-l-cut-visual.description: Editing. A held two-shot, the picture that would carry under the next line.

cine-crash-cut.title: Crash Cut
cine-crash-cut.description: Editing. A violent snap wider, as a crash cut breaks the size.

cine-flash-cut.title: Flash Cut
cine-flash-cut.description: Editing. A one-beat blast of light and a tighter frame.

cine-match-motion.title: Match Motion
cine-match-motion.description: Editing. A lateral move that could continue into the next shot.

cine-match-split.title: Match Split
cine-match-split.description: Editing. The frame splits its attention between two depths.

cine-quick-cuts.title: Quick Cuts
cine-quick-cuts.description: Editing. Three fast punches of size along one axis, played as one snap in.

cine-set-transition.title: Set Transition
cine-set-transition.description: Editing. The camera rises off one view, the way a transition would leave a set.

cine-transitions.title: Transitions
cine-transitions.description: Editing. A whip from one side of the subject to the other.

cine-fragments.title: Fragments
cine-fragments.description: Editing. A tight, off-center crop, one fragment of the body.

cine-rain.title: Rain
cine-rain.description: Atmosphere. Rain falls on the street around the figure.

cine-fog.title: Fog
cine-fog.description: Atmosphere. A thick fog sits in the set.

cine-mist.title: Mist
cine-mist.description: Atmosphere. A lighter mist than the fog shot, low around the legs.

cine-haze.title: Atmospheric Haze
cine-haze.description: Atmosphere. A warm haze between the camera and the figure.

cine-smoke.title: Smoke
cine-smoke.description: Atmosphere. Smoke pools around the figure.

cine-dust-motes.title: Dust Motes
cine-dust-motes.description: Atmosphere. Fine dust hangs in a shaft of window light.

cine-steam.title: Steam
cine-steam.description: Atmosphere. Pale steam rises in the workshop.

cine-snow.title: Snow
cine-snow.description: Atmosphere. Snow falls in the snow set.

cine-wet-down.title: Wet-Down
cine-wet-down.description: Atmosphere. A light rain on the reflective street, the wet-down look.

cine-sparks.title: Sparks and Embers
cine-sparks.description: Atmosphere. Sparks and a warm key, as from a nearby fire.

cine-dust-storm.title: Dust and Sand
cine-dust-storm.description: Atmosphere. Dust blows across the desert set.

cine-underwater.title: Underwater
cine-underwater.description: Atmosphere. A blue haze and drifting motes over the sea set.

cine-ocean.title: Ocean
cine-ocean.description: Atmosphere. A wide view on the open sea, with spray.

cine-film-noir.title: Film Noir
cine-film-noir.description: Genre. A low-key, canted street frame.

cine-neo-noir.title: Neo-Noir
cine-neo-noir.description: Genre. Neon and a low key on the night street.

cine-german-expressionism.title: German Expressionism
cine-german-expressionism.description: Genre. A hard canted angle and a stark key.

cine-giallo-look.title: Giallo
cine-giallo-look.description: Genre. A saturated, slightly evil close frame with a primary-colored key.

cine-spaghetti-western.title: Spaghetti Western
cine-spaghetti-western.description: Genre. A low, wide, dusty view in the desert.

cine-found-footage-look.title: Found Footage
cine-found-footage-look.description: Genre. A wide, rolled, uneasy handheld push.

cine-french-new-wave.title: French New Wave
cine-french-new-wave.description: Genre. A casual jump in on a street, a little off center.

cine-wuxia-look.title: Wuxia
cine-wuxia-look.description: Genre. A rising crane in the jungle, with the figure lifted.

cine-tech-noir.title: Tech Noir
cine-tech-noir.description: Genre. Magenta practicals and a cold rim on a dark street.

cine-southern-gothic.title: Southern Gothic
cine-southern-gothic.description: Genre. Warm, dim, heavy light and a still porch-like frame.

cine-cosmic-horror-look.title: Cosmic Horror
cine-cosmic-horror-look.description: Genre. A low, wide, sickly frame in the void, with a slow roll.

cine-vaporwave-look.title: Vaporwave
cine-vaporwave-look.description: Genre. Pink light, a centered statue-like pose, and a reflective floor.

cine-documentary-look.title: Documentary
cine-documentary-look.description: Genre. A modest zoom in, the observational push of a documentary.

cine-blockbuster-gloss.title: Blockbuster Gloss
cine-blockbuster-gloss.description: Genre. A low, bright, polished hero push.

cine-arthouse.title: Arthouse
cine-arthouse.description: Genre. A long, still, off-center hold.

cine-animation.title: Animation
cine-animation.description: Genre. A clean, graphic, slightly wide frame with a saturated key.

cine-bts.title: BTS
cine-bts.description: Genre. A wider, casual view of the workshop, as if from the crew.

cine-dreamcore.title: Dreamcore
cine-dreamcore.description: Genre. A soft, empty, slightly wrong-height frame in a bare stage.

cine-dystopian.title: Dystopian
cine-dystopian.description: Genre. A hard, desaturated wide view of the street.

cine-magical-realism.title: Magical Realism
cine-magical-realism.description: Genre. An ordinary medium frame, with the figure lifted a little off the floor.

cine-maximalism.title: Maximalism
cine-maximalism.description: Genre. Three figures, a hot color and almost no empty space.

cine-photography.title: Photography
cine-photography.description: Genre. A locked 85 mm style portrait.

cine-pixel-art.title: Pixel Art
cine-pixel-art.description: Genre. The low, chunky N64 look on a simple centered frame.

cine-stylistic-suck.title: Stylistic Suck
cine-stylistic-suck.description: Genre. A badly placed, tilted, too-close wide shot.

cine-video-game.title: Video Game
cine-video-game.description: Genre. A third-person follow with the low console look.

cine-weirdcore.title: Weirdcore
cine-weirdcore.description: Genre. An empty room, a wrong horizon and a pale grade.

cine-agamemnon.title: Agamemnon
cine-agamemnon.description: Look. A low, bronze, heroic push, like a tragedy mask filling the frame.

cine-ink-riot.title: Ink Riot
cine-ink-riot.description: Look. A hard graphic side light and a canted close view.

cine-fallen-angel.title: Fallen Angel
cine-fallen-angel.description: Look. The figure is lifted, backlit, and the camera looks up.

cine-fairytale-castle.title: Fairytale Castle
cine-fairytale-castle.description: Look. A high storybook view of the citadel with the figure small.

cine-comic.title: Comic
cine-comic.description: Look. A punch-in under a flat yellow key.

cine-cold-vision.title: Cold Vision
cine-cold-vision.description: Look. A blue, clinical close view.

cine-casual-monster-slayer.title: Casual Monster Slayer
cine-casual-monster-slayer.description: Look. A relaxed medium-wide stance, a little low.

cine-mighty-fighter.title: Mighty Fighter
cine-mighty-fighter.description: Look. A low, powerful push on the body.

cine-canvas.title: Canvas
cine-canvas.description: Look. A still, painterly three-quarter under a soft warm key.

cine-pigeons.title: Pigeons
cine-pigeons.description: Look. A street-level wide view, as if the frame belonged to the square.

cine-superstar.title: Superstar
cine-superstar.description: Look. A glam spotlight and a slow half-orbit.

cine-pearl-earring.title: Pearl Earring
cine-pearl-earring.description: Look. A dark three-quarter, turned like the painted portrait.

cine-lsd.title: LSD
cine-lsd.description: Look. A wide, rolling, acid-colored drift.

cine-blue-depth.title: Blue Depth
cine-blue-depth.description: Look. A long blue view with haze, so the depth reads as color.

cine-knights-diary.title: Knight's Diary

cinematic.title: Cinematic environment
cinematic.help: Choose a background image and select Full scene background in its Surface control. The image fills the frame; it is an illustrated backdrop, not 3D architecture.
cinematic.idleHelp: Uses the selected animation at its start offset with subtle body movement. Choose a relaxed frame of an idle or walking clip; no animation is transferred between rigs.
cinematic.floorSourceHeight: Lower backdrop portion used as floor

imageLook.title: Image appearance
imageLook.colorKeyHelp: Select the leftover background color to clear enclosed gaps and edges. Start with low tolerance to preserve details. Applies to this image or moving layer; you can turn it off at any time.

windows.title: Transparent windows ({{count}})
windows.help: Click around the opening and choose Save window. Drag points to refine the outline. Place a video layer behind it: the frame, wall and props keep their original image. The source image is unchanged.

poses.help: Each pose holds for its interval while the environment keeps moving. Use transparent PNG cutouts; adjust height and position to keep the character size and ground contact consistent.

pixelWorld.title: Pixel light
pixelWorld.help: The world is painted in palette slots: changing the palette relights every pixel, like colour-cycling art.
